summary: Diff implements major parts of the Banarasi expansion: heuristic client-side grouping into 7 collections, scroll-revealed collection sections with a gold wave divider, carousel sections with autoplay disabled under reduced-motion, pearl shimmer ambience, upgraded ProductCard interactions (lazy-loaded images, mannequin-style framing, micro-ripples, wishlist/add-to-cart actions) plus fly-to-cart animation, and SPA metadata updates via a new hook. Some specified naming and carousel navigation requirements are not clearly met in the provided diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Collection names aligned with: Zari Legacy, Silk Symphony, Royal Motif, Blooming Banarasi, Midnight Elegance, Celestial Threads, Eternal Gold.
missing_requirements.reason: The grouping utility and showcase text indicate a different ‘Royal’ collection naming/id (‘royal-heritage’ / ‘Royal Heritage Weaves’) rather than the requested ‘Royal Motif’.

missing_requirements.requirement: Each category carousel supports next/prev arrows and dot indicators on both desktop and mobile.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows carousel arrows (CarouselNext/CarouselPrevious imports) but does not provide evidence of dot navigation/indicators being rendered.

missing_requirements.requirement: Product image click supports a zoom-lens style interaction (from product card) and provides navigation path to full PDP overlay while preserving quick view behavior.
missing_requirements.reason: ProductCard image click is wired to open the detail view (PDP overlay), but the diff summary does not show a zoom-lens style interaction on the product-card image itself (only lazy-loaded and click handler).

hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any REQ-10 through REQ-19 acceptance criteria; Collections experience is specified as scroll reveal + carousels rather than infinite scroll.
